tagline: Leading broadband communications provider transforming connectivity
hero_kpi_rationale: Company segment driver representing 60.1% of total revenues, with EBITDA margins approximately 3 times higher than residential video and expected long-term growth

kpis.name: Residential Data Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue generated by residential data services in total revenue
kpis.description: Residential data services represent the majority of the company's total revenue and are the primary growth driver
kpis.signal: Key revenue stream for the company

kpis.short: Adjusted EBITDA Margin Residential Data vs Video
kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin Residential Data vs Video
kpis.explanation: Adjusted profit margin ratio between residential data and residential video
kpis.description: The adjusted EBITDA margin for residential data is approximately 3 times higher than for residential video, reflecting significantly lower programming and retransmission costs
kpis.signal: Significant margin advantage in the data segment

kpis.name: Business Data Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue generated by business data services in total revenue
kpis.description: Business data services represent 15.3% of total revenue and deliver EBITDA margins approximately 4 times higher than residential video

kpis.name: Residential Video Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue generated by residential video services in total revenue
kpis.description: Residential video accounts for 12.5% of total revenue and faces structural decline due to OTT competition and high programming costs

kpis.name: Average Monthly Data Usage per Residential Customer
kpis.explanation: Average data usage in gigabytes per residential customer per month
kpis.description: Average monthly data usage per residential customer is 835 gigabytes, with over 30% of customers consuming more than 1 terabyte per month, confirming network infrastructure robustness
kpis.signal: Increasing usage and strong available network capacity

kpis.name: Peak Bandwidth Utilization
kpis.explanation: Percentage of available peak bandwidth capacity being used
kpis.description: Peak bandwidth utilization remains at or below 20%, indicating significant available network capacity for future growth

kpis.name: Total Customers
kpis.explanation: Total number of residential and business customers served
kpis.description: The company serves approximately 1.0 million residential and business customers, positioning Cable One as a major provider in its niche markets

kpis.name: Passings
kpis.explanation: Number of homes and businesses with potential access to services
kpis.description: The company has access to approximately 2.9 million passings, providing a large potential market base with a current penetration rate of approximately 34%
kpis.signal: Established network footprint with penetration potential

kpis.name: Data Services Subscribers
kpis.explanation: Total number of subscribers to residential and business data services
kpis.description: Approximately 999,000 subscribers, or about 87% of the total customer base, are subscribed to data services, confirming the successful strategic pivot toward data
kpis.signal: Strong and strategic data subscriber base

risks.title: Increased competition in video and data services
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted at the beginning of the document. The company operates in a highly competitive sector against well-capitalized wireline, municipal, wireless, and OTT providers that threaten market share and margins

risks.title: Structural decline of residential video
risks.score_rationale: Residential video represents 12.5% of revenues with significantly lower margins. Programming and retransmission costs (59-63% of video revenues) and OTT competition create structural downward pressure

risks.title: Need for ongoing infrastructure investments
risks.score_rationale: Approximately 71% of investments since 2017 have been dedicated to infrastructure. The company must continue investing to maintain its competitive position and support data growth (835 GB/month average usage)

ai_positioning.summary: Cable One does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 annual report.
